title: Demario Davis wants to be "an example of what winning culture looks like" for Jets

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Demario Davis wants to be "an example of what winning culture looks like" for Jets
sources.description: After linebacker Demario Davis agreed to sign with the Jets in March, he shared that he was eager to be a part of what head coach Aaron Glenn is building as he moves into his second season on the job.
